fields.description: Cloudflare Realtime (Calls) App ID. Never expose to browsers.
fields.label: Cloudflare Realtime App ID

fields.description: App Secret / Bearer token for rtc.live.cloudflare.com. Server-side only.
fields.label: Cloudflare Realtime App Secret

fields.description: Use self when Domino Stream is installed on the same site as Domino101 Live Now (in-process start/stop, no HTTP). Otherwise the full base URL of remote www, e.g. https://www.domino101.com
fields.label: www Site URL

fields.description: Frappe API key pair api_key:api_secret for remote www start_stream / stop_stream. Not required when www Site URL is self.
fields.label: www API Key

fields.description: Optional Ant-parity guest webhook (default derived from www Site URL + streamer.hooks). POSTs liveStreamStarted/Ended with source=domino_stream.
fields.label: www Webhook URL

fields.description: Seconds without a publisher heartbeat before it counts as stale. The saved value is used as-is.
fields.label: Publisher Heartbeat Grace (seconds)

fields.description: Seconds to wait for keep_alive after a kill challenge opens. The saved value is the wait. Empty uses 20.
fields.label: Kill Challenge Grace (seconds)

fields.description: Shared key DCMS/Connect/www send as X-Domino-Stream-Key (or Authorization Bearer)
fields.label: Inbound API Key
